entries.09962dc5405a50e7: Its strengths are a group of proprietary patented methods that achieve decarbonized dismantling ahead of the rest of the world, including the 'Apple Peeling Method,' which greatly reduces high-altitude work in dismantling spherical storage tanks; the 'Windmill Toppling Method,' which calculates the toppling axis to safely topple structures; and the remote-controlled cutting robot 'Ringo☆Star.'
